notes.title: NEW UPDATE! BALANCES/ FIXES/ CHANGES
notes.content:
*****This new update MAY break maze sections for old save files. If this happens, i have included the old game version you can open instead, until you are done with that save file. It is in the same steam folder as all the game files.*******

changes:
-Ammo spirit now continues cranking out ammo even if you leave the room
-fairy spirit moves slightly faster
-fairy no longer pops the fetus boss bubbles
-shield spirit can block more often
-Lightning and capture magic takes less mana to cast
-slightly more time to react on shadow boss
-boss rush spiciness meter is a bit more forgiving
-mouse buttons rotational control shown on unclear puzzles
-kid in woods now behaves as intended, location more random
-hide and seek mode now shows spikes on map when they appear
-fanart and ai image galleries extended a bit to include newer entries
-addes previous game build to folder
